objective: Author and independently challenge one additive SSI canonical contract repair without experiment execution.

candidates.title: SSI canonical v11 byte, semantic, cost, replay, and control-gate repair
candidates.uncertainty: Whether the v10 independent review residuals can be closed in a single typed design contract without hiding advice, semantic edge work, finite sampling, cost, memory, controls, or incumbent comparison.
candidates.positive_decision: Preserve a review-supported design contract and name the next separately authorized materialization step; this batch still executes nothing.
candidates.negative_decision: Record the exact unresolved contract obstruction and keep the successor unfreezable; no mathematical negative about SSI or ECDLP follows.
candidates.inconclusive_decision: Record REVISE and the cheapest remaining contract repair or falsification control; no experiment is admitted.
candidates.next_action: Snapshot the v11 contract, obtain independent Validator and Red Team verdicts, then archive a narrow Coordinator disposition.

ambiguities.question: Does a complete design contract authorize execution or establish an SSI result?
ambiguities.resolution: No. V11 has maximum_runs zero, execution_authorized false, evidence_eligible false, and explicit missing-input hard gates.
ambiguities.basis: The v11 specification and its completion_gate.

candidates.dominated_by: Matched classical SSI/EndRing baselines remain the reference point; no Pareto improvement is claimed until semantic edges, controls, incumbent, and measured cost are materialized.

sota_delta.note: Design and review only; no algorithmic improvement is measured or claimed.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: Immutable v11 snapshot plus fresh independent review-adversarial verdicts bound to that snapshot.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: REVISE preserves the successor at unverified design status and names one bounded next contract action.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Any missing field width, digest preimage, target quantifier, semantic edge relation, charge, buffer interval, replay identity, control receipt, or incumbent input is REVISE rather than inferred PASS.
peripheral_exclusions: Any experiment run or backend diagnostic
Provider work, edge implementation, or control materialization
Any hypothesis or research-question status change
Any claimed breakthrough, lower bound, security result, or goal completion
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: The independent reviews and Coordinator disposition are ledger-archived.

resource_estimate.dominant_cost: Contract reconstruction, exact byte arithmetic, and independent adversarial review; no curve computation.
resource_estimate.complexity_hypothesis: Design work is bounded by symbolic schema and accounting review, not by ECDLP instance size.
resource_estimate.sharding_plan: One active candidate; snapshot and archive tasks run alone, with Validator and Red Team sessions reviewing only the snapshot.
resource_estimate.stop_rule: Stop after one snapshot, two independent verdicts, and one ledger disposition, or immediately on an archive-integrity failure.

stages.stop_rule: Stop if any opening or archive gate fails.

stages.purpose: Author and self-audit the v11 successor.
stages.dominant_operation: Wire, semantic, cost, memory, replay, and control contract review.
stages.stop_rule: Stop after the declared producer artifacts or on budget exhaustion.

stages.dominant_operation: Adversarial reconstruction of schema, oracle, semantic, cost, and control gates.

stages.purpose: Snapshot and ledger-archive the bounded disposition.
stages.dominant_operation: Exact-path hashing, commits, and repository validation.
stages.stop_rule: Stop on any integrity mismatch; otherwise after the verified ledger archive.
